case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your quote and the clear payment and contract terms. Your broad product range is a good basis for consolidating the complete kit with you.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Our analysis supports an ambitious bundle price in exchange for consolidating the complete kit under a longer commitment, with dependable delivery a condition of awarding the additional scope. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining your quoted terms; please choose the package that best supports your capacity planning.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.14 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We value our relationship and welcome your pricing committee’s consideration of this consolidated package.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the opportunity to consolidate this kit and the confirmed increase in volume. In recognition of the 24-month commitment and the higher quantities, we can revise our offer to €5.51 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment terms. This represents a substantial concession from our initial proposal, reflecting our strong interest in developing a long-term partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

To summarize, our Angebot includes a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
